title: Qualify rope-rigid contact
requires: Any development host and one physical production driver advertising the exact capability tuple
scope: Publish and bind vendor-neutral qualification for exactly ROPE/RIGID_BODY/DISTINCT_FAMILY/CONTACT/BIDIRECTIONAL/ENDPOINT_NATIVE. The single physical behavior is: Rope and rigid geometry prevent overlap at the declared radius and exchange reciprocal normal response without hidden attachment.
acceptance: Publish one immutable analytic profile for the listed tuple or representation variants, with canonical public-API inputs, SI units, bounded tolerances and an oracle independent of driver-private state.
Retain the existing exact lifecycle binding and prove the new analytic fixture does not broaden or substitute for its capacity, replacement and rollback obligations.

Bind only the exact tuple records in capability-obligations-v1 and rebuild the evidence index; retain failures, leave unrecaptured drivers unqualified, and remove any production advertisement that cannot satisfy the contract.

PASS: rope-core execution completed all 3 checkpoints and repeated byte-identically; exact lifecycle binding retained.
LIMITATION RETAINED: historical CUDA rope-core golden differs by 242 broad contact values; exact CUDA row remains unqualified, no golden or tolerance changed, F5-56 owns adjudication.
